Title: Azure Functions—Java 8 support on Linux is now in preview

Body.Content:
Linux hosting for Azure Functions applications built with Java 8 is now in preview. This enables bringing Java container workloads to Azure Functions and Kubernetes with KEDA. Additionally, use Gradle or Azure toolkit for IntelliJ IDEA to develop, debug, and deploy Azure Functions with Java (in preview).  

  • Learn more about Functions support for Java custom containers.
  • Learn more about Functions support for Gradle.
  • Learn more about Functions support with Azure toolkit for IntelliJ IDEA.
